scenario.label_zh: 饮酒后请求安全返家帮助
scenario.goal_zh: 说明无法自行开车并与清醒的朋友约定乘出租车回家。

context_zh: 聚会结束后，一名喝醉的参加者向没有喝酒的朋友求助。
author: author-phase05-b

sentences.speaker: Cal
sentences.text: Could you do me a favor? I am drunk, and I should not drive home.

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: Of course. Leave your car here. Would you like me to get a taxi with you?

sentences.speaker: Cal
sentences.text: Yes, please. I do not want to wait outside on my own.

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: We can wait inside by the front desk until it arrives. I have not been drinking.

sentences.speaker: Cal
sentences.text: Thanks. I will collect the car tomorrow, not tonight.

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: All right. Stay here with me while I arrange the ride.
